en_title: Daredevil Star Charlie Cox Confirms He's in an Unannounced Sega Game | NYCC 2026
cn_title: 《夜魔侠》主演确认参演世嘉新作
subtitle: 四十小时的美式口音
opus_summary: 查理·考克斯确认已为世嘉一款尚未公布、还没有名字的游戏完成录音。他透露录制台词花了约40小时，需使用美式口音，而制作团队起初误以为他是美国人。

paragraphs.en: Daredevil star Charlie Cox has confirmed that he is starring in another video game, this one for Sega.
paragraphs.cn: 《夜魔侠》主演查理·考克斯确认，他又参演了一款电子游戏，这次是世嘉的作品。

paragraphs.en: Cox opened up about the project at New York Comic-Con 2026, telling IGN’s Jeffrey Vega that he’s completed recording for an as-yet unannounced Sega video game.
paragraphs.cn: 考克斯在2026年纽约漫展上谈到了这个项目。他告诉IGN的Jeffrey Vega，自己已经为一款尚未公布的世嘉游戏完成了录音。

paragraphs.en: “I did another one! It doesn’t have a name yet,” he said. “I did a Sega one. I’ve done one since. It hasn’t come out yet. It was fun to do. It’s hard. It’s a whole different job, man.”
paragraphs.cn: 他说：「我又参与了一款！它还没有名字。我参与的是世嘉的一款游戏。那之后我又做了一款，还没推出。录制过程很有趣，也很难。这完全是另一种工作啊。」

paragraphs.en: Cox went on to share a humorous anecdote about his experience working on the game, saying that the crew weren’t aware that he wasn’t American.
paragraphs.cn: 考克斯接着分享了参与这款游戏时的一件趣事：制作团队原本并不知道他不是美国人。

paragraphs.en: “I’m not sure what I’m allowed to say, but I showed up for it, and I met them for the first time, they asked me to do this game, and so I agreed to it. Then I had to do 40 hours or whatever it was, and I showed up for the first day, and I was like, ‘Hi guys, nice to meet you! How are you?’ And all of them went, ‘...oh, he’s English.’ They’d hoped, they’d wanted him to be American. But now I’ve got to do 40 hours of lines I’ve not prepared in an accent. Yeah, I think they thought I was American.”
paragraphs.cn: 「我不确定哪些事可以说。他们邀请我参与这款游戏，我答应了，到了现场才第一次见到他们。我得录40个小时左右，具体多久我也记不清了。第一天到场时，我说，『大家好，很高兴见到你们！你们好吗？』所有人都愣了一下，说，『……哦，他是英国人。』他们原本希望找的是个美国人。但我现在得用另一种口音，录上40个小时的台词，而且事先没准备过这种口音。是啊，我想他们以为我是美国人。」

paragraphs.en: This, at least, gives us one bit of information about his role in the mysterious game — he’ll be playing an American character (or at least, a character with an American accent), and it’s likely that his role will be central to the plot, given that he recorded 40 hours’ worth of lines for it.
paragraphs.cn: 至少，我们由此得知了他在这款神秘游戏中所饰角色的一点信息：他将扮演一名美国人，或者至少是一个说话带美式口音的角色。考虑到他为这个角色录了40个小时的台词，这个角色很可能在剧情中占据重要地位。

paragraphs.en: It's also worth noting that Cox confirmed he was working on a new game earlier this year, though he similarly declined to mention many details at the time.
paragraphs.cn: 值得一提的是，考克斯今年早些时候就确认自己正在参与一款新游戏，不过当时他同样没有透露太多细节。

paragraphs.en: Thus far, that’s all we know. Cox has already proven his voice acting chops with Expedition 33 , where he played Gustave, famously recording all of his lines in a mere four-hour session. Players lauded his performance after the game released in 2025, and he was even nominated for Best Performance at the Game Awards that year.
paragraphs.cn: 目前，我们知道的就只有这些。考克斯已在《光与影：33号远征》中证明了自己的配音实力。他为古斯塔夫配音，而且仅用一次四小时的录音就录完了全部台词，这件事广为人知。游戏于2025年发售后，他的表演获得了玩家的称赞，还让他获得了当年The Game Awards最佳表演奖的提名。

paragraphs.en: Sega’s upcoming lineup of video game releases includes Stranger Than Heaven , Virtua Fighter Crossroads , Persona 6 , and Alien: Isolation 2 , among several others. Given that this particular project doesn’t even have a name yet, it’s unlikely that it’s any of these that have already been announced, so we’ll just have to wait and see what’s in store.
paragraphs.cn: 世嘉即将推出的游戏包括《异于天堂》《Virtua Fighter Crossroads》《女神异闻录6》和《异形：隔离2》等多部作品。考虑到考克斯参与的这个项目连名字都还没有，它不太可能是上述已经公布的游戏之一，具体会是什么，我们只能拭目以待。

paragraphs.en: In the meantime, fans of Charlie Cox can look forward to Daredevil: Born Again Season 3, though this is set to be the end of Matt Murdock’s current adventures — at least for the time being. The news broke in late September alongside reports that its showrunner, Dario Scardapane, exited the series while it was in post-production.
paragraphs.cn: 与此同时，查理·考克斯的粉丝可以期待《夜魔侠：重生》第三季，不过这一季将为马特·默多克当前的冒险画上句号——至少暂时如此。这个消息在9月下旬传出，同期还有报道称，该剧主创Dario Scardapane在剧集进入后期制作阶段时退出了项目。

paragraphs.en: Kingpin actor Vincent D’Onofrio penned a heartfelt goodbye to the series on social media, writing, “We have the final Season, season 3 heading your way next year with some very cool stuff. Much love to all who have been supportive. I love that character Fisk. Always will. Off to another neck off the woods. Meanwhile… Season 3 is coming!”
paragraphs.cn: 金并的饰演者文森特·多诺费奥在社交媒体上写下了一段真挚的告别文字：「我们最后一季，也就是第三季，将在明年与大家见面，里面有一些非常精彩的内容。衷心感谢所有支持过我们的人。我爱菲斯克这个角色，永远都会爱。我要去别处了。与此同时……第三季就要来了！」

paragraphs.en: Daredevil Born Again: Season 3 is set to release in early 2027.
paragraphs.cn: 《夜魔侠：重生》第三季定于2027年初播出。
